channel.title: The Claudia Winkleman Show
channel.desc: Claudia is joined by BAFTA winner James McAvoy, talking about his directorial debut; actor and producer of Mamma Mia and My Big Fat Greek Wedding Rita Wilson, chatting about her sixth studio album; star of Apple series The Morning Show, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, discussing her crime thriller, Fuze; and comedian Russell Howard on his stand-up tour, Don't Tell The Algorithm.
